highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews Skia m156, a GTK4 GPU view, and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery.
highlights_body: GTK4 painting now distinguishes physical backing pixels from logical coordinates. The preview also aligns .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and raises the Tizen baseline; later Apple and Uno changes are not part of Preview 1.

breaking.title: Choose GTK4 paint coordinates explicitly
breaking.body: SKDrawingArea now allocates high-density backing at physical resolution, and its default CanvasSize and paint Info use physical pixels. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true for logical paint coordinates while retaining full-resolution backing; RawInfo remains physical and GTK input coordinates stay logical. The new SKGLArea follows the same contract.

breaking.title: Move Tizen applications to the Tizen 10 baseline
breaking.body: New SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Tizen native packages target net10.0-tizen10.0 and support x64/arm64 with Tizen 10 and GCC 14.2 native builds. Tizen 8/9 and the old 32-bit/Clang paths are not supported. Retarget applications and native build environments; other platforms retain their existing .NET minimums.

bullets.detail: Updates the renderer to milestone m156. HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100 is a new package revision bucket, not an upgrade from native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, optional render loop, and IgnorePixelScaling. Invalidate through GTK QueueRender; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy. The render loop defaults off.

Restores directory-backed font discovery without introducing fontconfig. The default directory is /usr/share/fonts/ unless overridden at native build time; a fontless directory still yields the existing empty-family fallback.

SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp select Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11 targets, replacing the preview-only 5.0.6 artifacts. .NET 8 remains on 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 on 3.1.56, with threading/SIMD choices preserved.

Aligns Windows builds with the selected v143 toolset and matching Spectre CRT, and propagates CFG/security-cookie flags through ANGLE compilation. CRT provenance does not establish whole-program Spectre instrumentation.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored directory-backed font discovery for Linux NoDependencies builds without adding a fontconfig dependency.

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and Emscripten 6.0.2 selection for .NET 11. New Tizen native packages require Tizen 10.

harfbuzz_summary: WebAssembly assets select Emscripten 6.0.2 for .NET 11 targets, and new Tizen packages require Tizen 10. Windows builds align the selected v143 toolset with matching Spectre CRT libraries; native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 Preview 1 adds GTK4 GPU rendering and restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery.
